title: PMWeatherCM1
description: Addon for Protomanly's Weather that adds physically simulated storms
body:
![New cloud visuals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccfdef207fb7cd660657a52cd7216805b86e0275.png)
Physically simulated weather in Minecraft, beautiful, huge, turbulent, realistic

**Installation guide:**
1. Install Protomanly's Weather
2. Install this addon
3. Download simulation pack from here: https://github.com/odvigajlo/PMWeatherCM1/releases/
4. Put all simulations in .minecraft/config/pmweather/simulations (if those folders are missing, create them)
5. Allocate _atleast_ 4GB of RAM in launcher to avoid OOM errors
6. Enjoy! Wait for storms to spawn naturally or use /pmweather spawn scenario

Performance is about same as classic pmweather

**Known Issues:**

LAN and Multiplayer may be unstable, they havent been fully tested!

Other addon support or mod compatibility not guaranteed!
